/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import cv2, numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im=cv2.imread('first_frame.png')
hsv=cv2.cvtColor(im,cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
# yellow body + orange beak; add eye manually around left of head
m=(cv2.inRange(hsv,np.array([16,80,70]),np.array([42,255,255])))
# exclude warm wood/background by ROI
roi=np.zeros_like(m); roi[245:385,795:950]=255
m=cv2.bitwise_and(m,roi)
# eye: dark in expected box
eye=cv2.inRange(hsv,np.array([0,0,0]),np.array([179,255,90])); er=np.zeros_like(m); er[278:301,812:836]=255
eye=cv2.bitwise_and(eye,er); m=cv2.bitwise_or(m,eye)
m=cv2.morphologyEx(m,cv2.MORPH_CLOSE,np.ones((5,5),np.uint8))
m=cv2.morphologyEx(m,cv2.MORPH_OPEN,np.ones((3,3),np.uint8))
n,lab,stats,c=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(m)
keep=np.zeros_like(m)
for i in range(1,n):
 if stats[i,cv2.CC_STAT_AREA]>20: keep[lab==i]=255
m=keep
# show overlay and mask
out=im.copy(); out[m>0]=(0.5*out[m>0]+0.5*np.array([255,0,255])).astype(np.uint8)
cv2.imwrite('.tmp_mask.png',m)
cv2.imwrite('.tmp_overlay.png',out)
# inpaint base with expanded mask
m2=cv2.dilate(m,np.ones((5,5),np.uint8),iterations=1)
base=cv2.inpaint(im,m2,5,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)
cv2.imwrite('.tmp_base.png',base)
print('mask px',np.count_nonzero(m),'bbox',cv2.boundingRect(m))
PY"
